tagline: Understand what's possible. Decide what matters to you.

all.label: All resources
all.title: Resources
all.description: Browse reusable resources and projects. Find what fits your task, then copy it, download it or explore the source.

skills.label: Skills
skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Reusable task packages built around instructions, sometimes with templates, scripts or supporting files. Each skill will explain its requirements and setup.
skills.tileDescription: Reusable task packages, with requirements and setup guidance.
skills.emptyDescription: Released skills will appear here with their purpose, supported tools and setup steps.

prompts.label: Prompts
prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: Copyable starting points for a specific task. Add your context, paste into your AI assistant and refine the result.
prompts.tileDescription: Copyable starting points for a task, with space for your context.
prompts.emptyDescription: Released prompts will appear here with copyable text and usage steps.

templates.label: Templates
templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Reusable files that give a familiar task a clear starting structure.

workflows.label: Workflows
workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Repeatable processes with the steps and requirements needed to use them.

projects.label: Projects
projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Released tools and code projects, with documentation and source links.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Reusable rules and preferences that guide how an AI assistant works. Each set will explain where to save or paste it and when it applies.
instructions.tileDescription: Reusable rules and preferences for how your AI assistant should work.
instructions.emptyDescription: Released instruction sets will appear here with requirements and steps for saving or pasting them into your AI assistant.
